text: Between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, 12% of API requests failed with HTTP 502 errors. A deploy removed the cache warmup step. As a result, the cache was empty, and backend requests timed out under load. At 14:27 UTC, the team reverted the deploy. By 14:31 UTC, the error rate returned to normal. No data was lost during the incident. The team will add a check to the deploy process. This check will make sure that a cache warmup step runs before every deploy.
